name: Generic Genin

entries.name: Light-Footed
entries.text: You can Disengage or Dash as a bonus action. When an enemy moves adjacent to you, you can spend your reaction to move away up to half your speed.

entries.name: Pincer Movement
entries.text: When an ally moves adjacent to an enemy, you can spend your reaction to move up to your speed towards that same enemy.
This adversary is one of versatility. This adversary can select 2 additional Traits from any category it qualifies for.

entries.name: Tabula Rasa
entries.text: At the beginning of each of this adversary's turns, select one benefit that it will benefit from until the beginning of its next turn: • Attacks it makes gain a 1d4 bonus to hit. • Damage it deals gains a 1d6 bonus. • Skill checks it makes gain a 1d8 bonus.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Make 1 attack with a melee weapon, or 2 attacks with a ranged or thrown weapon.

entries.name: Kunai (Melee)
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

entries.name: Kunai (Ranged)
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

notes: Cha modifier printed as "+-2"; transcribed as -2.
